idea: SAM click success is a function of local contrast, not object semantics
problem: Users treat a failed SAM click as a semantic failure; it may be an encoder contrast failure.
hyp: Holding object category fixed, click IoU correlates more with local gradient energy than with CLIP similarity to the class name.
why: Changes how we prompt, train, and evaluate promptable segmentation.
novel: Separates appearance-energy vs semantic-identity accounts of SAM failure.
min_exp: COCO + SAM: regress click-IoU on local contrast vs CLIP-class similarity; partial correlation.
risk: Contrast and semantics are correlated; needs matched pairs.

idea: SAM multi-click refinement is not monotonically improving
problem: Interactive eval reports final IoU; intermediate clicks may hurt.
hyp: A non-trivial fraction of second/third clicks decrease IoU vs previous mask, especially near holes and adjacent instances.
why: Interactive protocols and UI assume monotonic refinement.
novel: Treats click trajectories as a dynamical system, not a single score.
min_exp: Replay SAM iterative clicks; measure P(IoU drop) by click index and error type.
risk: Click simulators may not match humans.

idea: SAM box prompts systematically ignore interior holes
problem: Box-conditioned masks fill holes in rings, text, medical lumens.
hyp: Hole recall is worse for box than for interior+exterior point pairs on the same objects, at matched box tightness.
why: Clinical structures are often topological (vessels, airways).
novel: Topology-conditioned prompt failure, not generic IoU.
min_exp: Synthetic rings + DRIVE/STARE vessels; box vs pos/neg clicks; hole-F1.
risk: May be known as a SAM limitation anecdotally without quantification.

idea: SAM IoU token is miscalibrated exactly where humans need it (ambiguous objects)
problem: Predicted IoU is used as a confidence for auto-mask.
hyp: ECE of IoU-token vs true IoU is highest in high-entropy regions (smoke, glass, overlapping instances).
why: Automatic mask generation ranking depends on this score.
novel: Links SAM confidence to visual ambiguity, not just size.
min_exp: AMG on COCO+transparency/smoke; bin ECE by boundary-entropy.

idea: SAM2 memory bank is a distractor amplifier in crowded video
problem: Memory attention is assumed to stabilize identity.
hyp: When ≥N similar instances coexist, memory attention entropy rises and ID switches increase vs memory-off.
why: Challenges ‘more memory is better’ for SAM2.
novel: Memory as a source of error, not only a cure.
min_exp: MOT/YouTube-VIS crowded clips; SAM2 with memory on/off/truncated.
risk: SAM2 already has ablation papers; need a precise distractor metric.

idea: Negative clicks in SAM act as a global prior, not a local veto
problem: Users expect a negative click to carve locally.
hyp: A negative click far from the object changes the mask more via decoder global tokens than via local feature suppression.
min_exp: Activation patching / token ablation in SAM decoder while moving neg clicks.
risk: Requires decoder internals; SAM variants differ.

idea: The medical SAM gap lives more in the decoder than the ViT encoder
problem: Papers full-FT everything; unclear where domain shift sits.
hyp: Linear/MLP decoder probe on frozen SAM encoder closes less of the CT/MRI gap than FT decoder with frozen encoder, which itself closes most of full-FT gain.
why: Tells PEFT where to spend parameters.
novel: Layer-wise locus of medical domain gap in SAM.
min_exp: Synapse/AMOS: freeze encoder vs freeze decoder vs full; matched steps.
risk: Optimizer interaction with freezing confounds capacity.

idea: Prompt jitter sensitivity is a better robustness metric than IoU for SAM-like models
problem: Single GT click protocols hide instability.
hyp: Models with equal mean IoU can differ 2× in IoU variance under Gaussian click jitter of σ=5–15px.
min_exp: Re-evaluate SAM/MedSAM/SAM-HQ with jittered clicks; rank shift.

idea: Small-object SAM failure is an absolute-pixel encoder issue, not a relative-size issue
hyp: Upsampling a small object to the same pixel area as a medium object recovers SAM IoU more than using a relative-size-matched crop without upsample.
why: Decides whether to fix resolution or attention.
min_exp: COCO small objects: upsample-in-box vs context-preserving crop; SAM IoU.

idea: Transparent object masks fail because SAM edges follow refraction caustics, not occluding contours
problem: Glass/plastic segmentation is blamed on ‘transparency’ vaguely.
hyp: Error pixels concentrate on high-gradient caustics more than on the true occluding contour annotated by humans.
why: Suggests geometry/light cues, not just more glass data.
novel: Physical-error localization vs generic domain gap.
min_exp: Trans10K: overlay error maps on caustic vs contour maps.

idea: Smoke segmentation models learn motion-correlated textures when trained on video frames treated as i.i.d.
problem: Smoke datasets often sample video; models may cheat with residual flicker.
hyp: Shuffling frame order at test or using single isolated frames drops IoU more for video-sampled smoke models than for still-photo-trained ones.
why: Fire safety models deployed on snapshots.
min_exp: Train on sequential vs shuffled; test isolated frames.

idea: Fire/smoke IoU overstates detection usefulness because false-alarm regions are small but operationally fatal
problem: Pixel IoU treats a 1% FP cloud as minor.
hyp: Ranking by IoU vs by image-level FAR at fixed recall disagrees on ≥30% of method pairs.
novel: Makes the metric-task mismatch the paper, not a new backbone.
min_exp: Re-rank public smoke methods by FAR@recall vs mIoU.

idea: SAM automatic mask generation over-segments medical organs into intensity subregions
problem: AMG is used as pseudo labels for medical SSL.
hyp: AMG mask count inside a GT organ scales with intensity variance, not with anatomical substructure count.
why: Pseudo-label SSL may inject intensity clusters as classes.
novel: Diagnoses AMG as intensity clustering in medical volumes.
min_exp: Count AMG masks vs organ GT vs local σ on CT.

idea: Slice-wise SAM on 3D CT is inconsistent along z because prompts are not 3D-stable
problem: 2.5D medical SAM papers report mean Dice.
hyp: Adjacent-slice mask IoU is lower than same-slice click-jitter IoU, indicating z-inconsistency beyond 2D instability.
min_exp: Propagate clicks to ±k slices; measure surface Hausdorff vs in-plane jitter.

idea: Foreground class imbalance in medical Dice hides empty-slice calibration failure
problem: Models output blobs on empty slices.
hyp: Empty-slice FPR is uncorrelated with organ Dice across models of similar Dice.
why: Screening series contain many empty slices.
min_exp: Recompute leaderboards with empty-slice FPR.
risk: Some datasets already exclude empty slices.

idea: Boundary errors in medical segmentation are dominated by annotation protocol disagreement, not model capacity
problem: Papers add boundary losses assuming GT is gold.
hyp: Inter-rater boundary disagreement ≥ model-vs-rater disagreement for at least one organ on a double-annotated subset.
why: Would cap the value of boundary losses.
min_exp: Double-annotate 50 cases; compare Hausdorff model vs rater.
risk: Expensive labels; may be known in radiology.

idea: Weak box supervision for segmentation fails when boxes are tight because models use box edges as object edges
problem: Box-supervised instance seg uses noisy boxes.
hyp: Tightening GT boxes by 5–10% increases boundary error more than loosening them, opposite to ‘better box = better mask’.
why: Challenges how we generate weak labels.
novel: Box tightness as a confounder, not a quality proxy.
min_exp: BBTP/BoxInst-style training with controlled box jitter.
risk: May depend on the specific weak method.

idea: Point-supervised segmentation learns annotator click priors (center bias) more than object shape
hyp: Shifting all training clicks from centroid to a consistent offset (e.g. 20% toward head) moves predicted mass in that direction at test, even for unseen classes.
novel: Click-location prior as a learned dataset artifact.
min_exp: Synthetic click-offset experiment on PASCAL.

idea: Detector NMS is a larger source of missed crowded objects than backbone features
hyp: Oracle NMS / no-NMS upper bound closes more of the crowd gap than swapping a stronger backbone at matched training.
why: Redirects effort from features to set prediction.
novel: Quantitative decomposition of crowd error sources.
min_exp: CrowdHuman: NMS oracle vs backbone swap.
risk: Oracle NMS definition can leak GT.

idea: Open-vocabulary detectors fail on rare visual modes of common classes, not on rare class names
problem: LVIS long-tail is treated as vocabulary rarity.
hyp: Within a frequent class, the rare visual mode has similar AP drop as a rare class with the same example count.
why: Changes long-tail from taxonomy to appearance coverage.
min_exp: Cluster CLIP embeddings within class; measure AP by mode rarity.

idea: SAM fails on thin structures because the mask decoder is trained with IoU that ignores topology
problem: IoU can be high with broken vessels.
hyp: Replacing IoU-only mask selection with a clDice/topology score at inference (no retraining) recovers more vessel connectivity than a small FT.
why: Tests whether training or selection is the bottleneck.
min_exp: DRIVE with SAM AMG reranked by clDice proxy vs FT.
risk: Need a GT-free topology proxy for AMG.

idea: Uncertainty maps from MC-dropout in segmentation correlate with distance-to-boundary, not epistemic novelty
problem: Papers treat high entropy as OOD.
hyp: After controlling for distance-to-boundary, residual entropy does not predict true OOD (new scanner) better than chance.
min_exp: Partial correlation entropy vs boundary-distance vs scanner-OOD AUROC.
risk: May be known in calibration literature.

idea: Test-time augmentation in segmentation helps calibration more than Dice
hyp: TTA ΔDice << TTA ΔECE on medical datasets at matched compute.
why: Reframes TTA as a calibration tool.
novel: Primary claim is calibration, not mIoU.
min_exp: UNet/nnU-Net TTA on/off; Dice and ECE.

idea: Domain-adaptive segmentation gains vanish when you match intensity histograms without any DA module
problem: DA papers compare to naive source-only.
hyp: Simple per-volume histogram matching recovers ≥50% of a published DA method’s Dice gain on a CT↔MRI or scanner-shift pair.
novel: Attacks DA significance, not proposing a module.
min_exp: Reproduce one DA paper + histogram-match baseline.
risk: Authors may have used this already in appendix.

idea: Synthetic medical images from diffusion improve encoder invariance but hurt boundary fidelity
problem: Synthetic data papers report Dice only.
hyp: Adding synthetic volumes raises region Dice and simultaneously raises Hausdorff; real-only has opposite Pareto.
why: Explains mixed reports on synthetic data.
novel: Pareto of invariance vs boundary, not a single score.
min_exp: Train with 0/25/50% synthetic; plot Dice vs HD95.

idea: CLIP text features are a worse class prior for dense prediction than a single prototype image
hyp: One real support image prototype beats the class text embedding on the same frozen CLIP for ≥K classes with visually inconsistent names.
why: Challenges text as the universal interface.
novel: Name-to-appearance inconsistency as the failure mode.
min_exp: CAT-Seg/OVSeg swap text vs 1-shot image proto.

idea: VLM dense predictors inherit the tokenizer’s spatial aliasing, not just the vision encoder’s
problem: People blame the ViT patch size.
hyp: Two VLMs with identical vision encoder but different language pooling/spatial adapters differ more in boundary F1 than two VLMs with different encoders and the same adapter.
novel: Language-side spatial bottleneck as the culprit.
min_exp: Controlled adapter swap on LLaVA-style dense heads.

idea: Instruction-tuned VLMs are worse dense labelers than the base VLM because alignment suppresses localization
problem: People use the chat checkpoint for annotation.
hyp: Base (pre-instruction) VLM has higher referring-seg IoU than the aligned chat model at the same vision encoder.
why: Would change which checkpoint labs should use.
min_exp: Same family base vs chat; RefCOCO / reasonseg.

idea: LoRA rank needed for segmentation is spatially heterogeneous: high at decoder skip, low at late ViT blocks
hyp: A budget-matched mix of ranks (high early decoder, low late encoder) beats uniform rank on Dice at equal trainable params.
why: PEFT as allocation, not a single r.
novel: Spatial/layer PEFT budget for dense tasks.
min_exp: SAM or SegFormer LoRA rank sweep per block.
risk: Search space; may look like NAS.

idea: LoRA on SAM image encoder mostly relearns intensity statistics, which a 1×1 conv on tokens could do
hyp: A per-channel affine on encoder tokens matches ≥70% of LoRA’s medical Dice gain.
novel: Minimal sufficient adaptation for SAM medical transfer.
min_exp: Affine-on-tokens vs LoRA-r=4/16 on Synapse.
risk: If false, still a needed baseline.

idea: Catastrophic forgetting in sequential organ FT is mostly a classifier-head issue, not a representation wipe
problem: Continual medical seg papers freeze or distill everything.
hyp: Replaying only the last linear classifier on stored embeddings recovers most old-organ Dice without embedding replay.
min_exp: Two-organ sequential FT; head replay vs feature replay.
risk: May fail when organs co-occur in one image.

idea: Prompt-tuning SAM is brittle because learned prompts overfit the click distribution of the FT set
hyp: VPT that matches standard FT on in-distribution clicks loses more under click-jitter than full FT.
why: Prompt methods may look good on the protocol they were tuned on.
min_exp: VPT vs FT; eval jittered clicks.

idea: DINOv2 features are linearly more segmentable than CLIP at the same patch size, but only for ‘stuff’ not ‘things’
hyp: Linear probe ADE20K: DINO>CLIP on stuff, CLIP≥DINO on things.
min_exp: Frozen linear probes; report stuff vs things.
risk: Close to existing VFM probes; need a clean split.

idea: MAE reconstructions optimize a loss that is anti-correlated with instance-boundary quality
problem: MAE is used as a dense pretrain.
hyp: Patch reconstruction error is lower in texture interiors than on instance boundaries; models that minimize MAE more do not get better boundary F1.
min_exp: Scatter MAE-val vs boundary-F1 across checkpoints.

idea: Foundation model fine-tuning ‘instability’ is mostly learning-rate × frozen-norm interaction, not data order
hyp: Fixing LN/BN handling (train vs eval stats) collapses seed variance of MedSAM-style FT more than averaging 5 data orders.
min_exp: Ablate BN/LN eval flags vs shuffle seeds.
risk: Too ‘engineering’ for a paper unless quantified widely.

idea: Zero-shot medical segmentation from VLMs fails because reports describe function, not pixels
hyp: Replacing clinical text with spatial phrases (‘dark region left of liver’) beats real report text for mask grounding on the same VLM.
why: Language supervision type, not domain vocabulary.
novel: Functional vs spatial language as the gap.
min_exp: Swap prompt style on a medical VLM seg benchmark.
risk: Need a dataset with both texts.

idea: Few-shot segmentation gains from ‘better prototypes’ are actually support-mask erosion of background leakage
hyp: Eroding support masks by 2–3px matches a published prototype-attention gain on 1-shot PASCAL-5i.
min_exp: Replicate one few-shot paper + erosion baseline.
risk: May only work on some methods.

idea: Self-training for segmentation amplifies label-mode collapse to the majority visual mode of a class
hyp: Rare visual modes lose recall across self-training generations while overall mIoU rises.
min_exp: Track per-mode recall over teacher generations.

idea: Cross-domain transfer of SAM is bottlenecked by prompt encoder quantization of location, not image features
hyp: On a domain shift, replacing the positional encoding scale of the prompt encoder recovers more than LoRA on the image encoder at matched param budget.
novel: Prompt positional calibration as domain adaptation.
min_exp: Retina/fundus vs natural: PE scale vs encoder LoRA.

idea: Robustness to weather/corruptions in segmentation is mostly low-frequency; high-frequency corruptions are already solved by ImageNet pretrain
hyp: After grouping corruptions into low vs high frequency, ImageNet-pretrained models are near-ceiling on high-freq and fail on low-freq fog/contrast.
why: Tells which robustness to work on.
min_exp: Cityscapes-C / ADE-C grouped results.

idea: Evaluation of referring segmentation is leaked by dataset language templates
hyp: A bag-of-words + detector baseline closes an unexpectedly large fraction of SOTA on templated expressions vs free expressions.
novel: Template vs free split as the audit.
min_exp: Parse templates; compare SOTA vs BoW.

idea: COCO mask quality, not model error, caps current instance-seg leaderboards
hyp: On a high-quality re-annotated subset, ranking of top models compresses and some inversions appear.
novel: GT noise as leaderboard confounder (LVIS/COCO-HQ style audit).
min_exp: Evaluate public checkpoints on COCO-HQ / manually cleaned 500 images.
risk: Annotation cost; related to LVIS/COCO analyses.

idea: Dice optimization creates overconfident interiors and neglected 1-pixel membranes
problem: Soft Dice is default in medical.
hyp: A model trained with Dice has higher interior ECE and worse 1-px membrane recall than CE at matched mean Dice.
why: Loss-induced failure mode, not a new loss for +0.5 Dice.
min_exp: nnU-Net Dice vs CE; membrane recall + ECE.
risk: Reviewers: ‘just compare losses’. Must be a diagnostic paper.

idea: Unproven assumption: more SAM pretraining data always helps medical transfer
hyp: On ≥1 medical target, original SAM outperforms a later larger-data SAM variant with frozen encoder + same decoder FT.
novel: Negative scaling result for promptable FM transfer.
min_exp: SAM vs SAM2 vs SAM-HQ transfer protocol matched.
risk: If SAM2 always wins, idea dies (cheap kill).

idea: Unproven assumption: higher natural-image linear-probe accuracy predicts better dense FT
problem: Labs pick VFMs by ImageNet/CLIP scores.
hyp: Spearman correlation between VFM classification probes and dense FT Dice across 6 VFMs is ≤0.2.
min_exp: 6 VFMs × 2 dense datasets; correlate rankings.

idea: Negative result: test-time prompt optimization for SAM overfits the first frame and harms video
hyp: Per-frame prompt opt improves image IoU and decreases SAM2 video J&F vs no TPT.
why: Stops a tempting but harmful recipe.
novel: Image TPT vs video consistency tradeoff.
min_exp: TPT on SAM2 first frame vs full video.

idea: Ambiguous objects should be scored as distributions over masks, not a single GT
problem: Smoke, cells, occlusions have many valid masks.
hyp: Model ranking reverses when switching from single-GT IoU to oracle-IoU against a set of 5 annotators.
why: Fundamental eval bug for ambiguous tasks.
min_exp: Collect 5 masks on 100 smoke/cell images; re-rank models.

idea: Object detection AP is dominated by localization-threshold conventions that disagree with human ‘detected’
hyp: Human yes/no detection judgments match AP@0.3 better than AP@0.5 for small objects.
min_exp: Small user study on 200 detections.

idea: Foundation models ‘zero-shot’ medical claims often include in-domain textual leakage from papers/wikis
hyp: Replacing disease names with nonce tokens in prompts drops performance more on famous diseases than on rare ones, indicating memorization.
min_exp: Rename classes in prompts; plot fame vs drop.

idea: Parameter-efficient FT that beats full FT is often undertrained full FT
problem: PEFT papers use smaller LR / fewer epochs for full FT.
hyp: A well-tuned full FT baseline with the same compute budget matches or beats the PEFT number in ≥2 MedSAM-LoRA papers.
novel: Compute-matched full FT as the real baseline.
min_exp: Retune full FT; compare.
risk: If PEFT still wins, still publishable as a replication.

idea: SAM’s image encoder has a center-object bias even without prompts
problem: Promptable models are assumed spatially uniform.
hyp: AMG mask density is higher at image center than a uniform object-location prior from COCO would predict.
min_exp: AMG on COCO images vs location histogram of GT.

idea: Medical intensity windowing is a larger ‘model’ choice than architecture
hyp: Sweeping window centers on CT changes Dice as much as swapping UNet vs SegFormer.
novel: Quantifies windowing vs architecture effect sizes.
min_exp: Paired sweep on LiTS.
risk: Too simple; needs a surprising crossover.

idea: Smoke opacity is a continuous physical state but models are trained on binary masks
hyp: A model trained on synthetic opacity regression transfers to binary smoke IoU better than binary-trained models at the same synthetic budget.
min_exp: Blender/synthetic smoke opacity vs binary.

idea: SAM-HQ extra decoder tokens improve boundaries mainly by copying image gradients, which a guided filter can mimic
hyp: Post-processing SAM masks with a guided filter / dense CRF recovers a large share of SAM-HQ’s boundary gain on HQSeg-44K.
min_exp: SAM + guided filter vs SAM-HQ.
risk: If HQ still wins big, idea mutates to residual HQ.

idea: Video object segmentation memory should forget on purpose at shot cuts, but models are not given cut detectors
hyp: Resetting memory at detected cuts improves J&F more than increasing memory length.
min_exp: SAM2 ± shot-cut reset on a mixed-cut set.

idea: Instance segmentation of overlapping cells fails at assignment, not at pixel classification
hyp: Pixel-wise semantic F1 of overlapping cells is already high; instance AP is low; an oracle connected-component on GT semantics still fails, implying assignment is the issue.
min_exp: Livecell/cellpose: semantic vs instance oracles.
risk: May be known to cell-tracking people.

idea: Long-tail segmentation mIoU is almost determined by how you sample the few-shot classes in training, not the head architecture
hyp: Replacing class-balanced sampling with natural frequency changes tail IoU more than replacing the decoder.
min_exp: Same model, two samplers; two decoders, one sampler.

idea: Calibration of segmentation should be instance-level because pixel-ECE is dominated by easy background
hyp: Models with excellent pixel-ECE have poor instance-level confidence ranking of predicted components.
novel: Instance ECE as the relevant score.
min_exp: Compute both on Cityscapes.

idea: Annotation-efficient active learning for seg selects images that are hard for the model but easy for humans, wasting budget
hyp: High-entropy images have lower human annotation time-normalized information gain than disagreement-with-SAM images.
min_exp: Measure annotator time on 100 images; compare policies.

idea: Generalization of medical models to a new hospital is predicted by intensity Wasserstein distance better than by Dice on a small target val set
hyp: Source-only Dice on target correlates worse with full-target Dice than a no-label intensity WD, for scanner shifts.
min_exp: Multi-hospital CT; correlate WD vs 5-shot Dice with full Dice.

idea: Multimodal supervision from reports improves classification of studies but not dense organ boundaries
problem: Vision-language medical pretrain papers report both.
hyp: Report-supervised pretrain ΔAUC >> ΔDice versus image-only pretrain.
why: Puts dense claims in their place.
min_exp: Same pretrain; probe cls vs seg.

idea: Representation mismatch: SAM tokens linearly decode edges better than semantic classes, opposite of DINOv2
problem: People treat all VFMs as semantic.
hyp: Linear probes: SAM>DINO on edges, DINO>SAM on ADE classes, both frozen.
min_exp: BSDS500 + ADE linear probes.
risk: SAM was trained with masks, so partly expected; quantify anyway.

idea: Surprising phenomenon: flipping medical images left-right changes Dice more for paired organs than for unpaired, revealing shortcut laterality
hyp: Models without flip aug fail more on left/right organ identity than on shape when images are mirrored.
min_exp: Train w/o flips; test mirrored.
risk: Too simple unless it bites SOTA.

idea: Community assumption: bigger input resolution is always better for SAM-style models
hyp: On small medical objects, a 512 crop around the prompt beats full 1024 on Dice at matched VRAM.
min_exp: MedSAM at 1024 vs prompt-crop 512.
risk: May already be in sliding-window papers.

idea: Negative result candidate: adding depth/anything-3D cues does not help transparent object seg
hyp: Predicted depth on glass is anti-correlated with true surface; fusion hurts vs RGB-only.
min_exp: Trans10K ± DepthAnything.
risk: If it helps, idea dies cheaply.

idea: New combination with mechanism: treat fire as a light source in inverse rendering, not as a texture class
problem: Fire is segmented as a red blob.
hyp: A model that predicts a residual glow map constrained by image formation outperforms a segmentation UNet on night fire with glare, at similar capacity.
min_exp: Synthetic glare fire + small real set.

idea: Detection of small smoke plumes fails because models use atmospheric haze as a positive cue
hyp: Adding fog-only negatives without fire reduces FAR more than adding more fire positives.
min_exp: Retrain with fog negatives; FAR/recall.

idea: SAM mask decoder cross-attention to image tokens is almost sparse; extra tokens are unused
hyp: Attention entropy to image tokens is concentrated on <10% of tokens for typical clicks; masking the rest at inference barely drops IoU.
min_exp: Attention rollout + token pruning.
risk: Known-ish for ViTs; still useful if quantified on SAM.

idea: Medical VFM pretraining on mixed public datasets leaks test patients via re-uploads
hyp: A membership inference or simple hash of 3D crops shows overlap between popular pretrain piles and ‘held-out’ test sets.
min_exp: Perceptual hash overlap scan.
risk: Legal/ethics of patient identity; keep de-identified.

idea: Zero-shot segmentation via VLMs is secretly two-stage detection + SAM, and the VLM only names the box
hyp: Replacing the VLM mask head with Grounding-DINO + SAM matches the VLM’s IoU on RefCOCO.
min_exp: Compare published VLM-seg vs GDINO+SAM.
risk: If VLM still wins on reasoning splits, mutate to those splits.

idea: PEFT interference: two LoRAs for two organs on the same SAM encoder add destructively in overlapping voxels
hyp: Sequential merge of organ-specific LoRAs drops Dice in overlap regions more than a jointly trained dual-head with one LoRA.
min_exp: Liver/tumor LoRAs merge vs joint.

idea: Simple hypothesis: connected-component cleanup after SAM is a stronger medical ‘method’ than extra adapters
hyp: SAM + anatomy-constrained CC (max 1 organ blob) beats MedSAM-Lite-style adapters on Dice for unpaired organs.
min_exp: Post-process vs adapter on Synapse unpaired organs.

idea: Unproven: self-attention is necessary for promptable segmentation
hyp: A conv encoder with a small prompt-conditioned FiLM decoder matches SAM on COCO 1-click for medium/large objects.
min_exp: Train a conv SAM-like on a subset.

idea: Evaluation weakness: panoptic PQ punishes medically irrelevant stuff classes that dominate the score
problem: Pathology is a small PQ term.
hyp: Dropping stuff classes reverses method ranking on a medical panoptic dataset.
min_exp: Recompute PQ things-only.

idea: Synthetic copy-paste for detection creates a depth/size inconsistency that models exploit as a shortcut
hyp: At test, objects with inconsistent shadow/size relative to scene are over-detected by copy-paste-trained models vs real-only.
min_exp: Controlled inconsistent inserts at test.
risk: May be known from cut-paste literature.

idea: Robustness: segmentation models’ worst-group is not rare classes but rare lighting of common classes
hyp: Clustering by illumination yields larger worst-group gap than class-based grouping on Cityscapes.
min_exp: Define illumination clusters; report WGA.

idea: Cross-domain: a model trained on surgical smoke generalizes to wildfire smoke better than the reverse
hyp: Asymmetric transfer: surgical→wildfire Dice drop < wildfire→surgical, because surgical smoke is a subset of aerosol appearance.
min_exp: Two datasets, both transfer directions.

idea: LLM-as-annotator for masks fails on spatial prepositions more than on class names
hyp: GPT-4V/LLaVA box proposals err more on ‘behind/left-of’ than on naming the object, measured against human boxes.
min_exp: Controlled referring expressions.

idea: Diffusion features for segmentation are most useful at mid-noise, not x0 prediction
problem: Papers pick a timestep ad hoc.
hyp: Linear probe mIoU vs diffusion t is unimodal peaking at mid t, and that peak beats DINO on boundaries but not on stuff.
min_exp: Stable Diffusion frozen probes over t.

idea: Super-resolution as a preprocessor for small-object detection can hurt because it hallucinates textures detectors love
hyp: A face/texture-oriented SR model increases FP on small objects more than it increases TP, dropping AP.
min_exp: COCO-small ± Real-ESRGAN.

idea: Image restoration before medical seg removes the disease cue (lesion contrast) along with noise
hyp: A denoiser trained on natural or simulated CT noise reduces lesion Dice while improving organ Dice.
novel: Organ vs lesion Pareto under denoise.
min_exp: Low-dose CT: denoise on/off.

idea: Generation for data augmentation in rare pathology is harmful when the generator cannot sample the rare mode
hyp: FID can improve while rare-lesion recall falls after adding generated images.
min_exp: Train with gen; track tail recall and FID.

idea: LLM fine-tuning for report generation can be used as a cheap semantic auditor of segmentation, not as a captioner
hyp: Asking an LLM whether a mask is consistent with the report catches a class of errors Dice misses (wrong laterality, missing organ).
min_exp: Synthetic laterality errors; LLM flag rate.
risk: LLM unreliability; keep as auditor study.

idea: Alignment of VLMs with RLHF reduces willingness to output uncertain masks, increasing overconfident complete objects
hyp: Aligned VLM more often returns a single full object when the click is ambiguous, vs base that abstains or returns multiples.
why: Safety vs honesty in dense tasks.
min_exp: Ambiguous-click set; abstain vs full-mask rates.
risk: Need access to base and aligned.

idea: Agentic evaluation of papers (LLM reviewer) systematically underrates negative-result and metric papers
problem: Using LLMs in the loop of this evolution.
hyp: LLM reviewers score ‘new module’ abstracts higher than ‘eval audit’ abstracts with matched writing quality.
min_exp: Blind LLM scores on 40 abstracts of two types.
risk: Meta, not CV; keep as internal audit too.

idea: SAM on ultrasound fails because speckle is treated as texture instances
hyp: Despeckle preprocessing helps SAM more than FT of the last encoder block, while the reverse is true on CT.
novel: US speckle vs CT intensity gap.
min_exp: CAMUS/US3M: despeckle vs last-block FT.

idea: Prompt sensitivity in SAM is worse at object-part boundaries than at object-object boundaries
hyp: Click IoU variance is higher when GT has part annotations (wheels, limbs) than for whole objects.
min_exp: Pascal-Part vs whole-object clicks.

idea: Medical few-shot using SAM is secretly few-shot of the prompt protocol, not of anatomy
hyp: Shuffling which slices are ‘support’ changes Dice as much as changing the organ.
min_exp: Many support draws; variance decomposition.

idea: Objectness in SAM is closer to ‘closed contour in RGB’ than to ‘physical object’
hyp: SAM AMG fires on shadows and painted logos at rates comparable to true objects after controlling for size.
min_exp: Count AMG on shadows/logos vs objects.

idea: Fine-tuning SAM on one medical site increases prompt-jitter sensitivity on that site
problem: FT is assumed to help everywhere.
hyp: In-site Dice up, jitter-variance up vs frozen SAM.
min_exp: Before/after FT jitter curves.
risk: May be fixed by jitter aug during FT (then that’s the paper).

idea: Detection limitation: query-based detectors duplicate on transparent objects because queries lock onto both surface and background
hyp: Duplicate-detection rate is higher on transparent instances than opaque of same size.
min_exp: DETR on Trans10K boxes.

idea: Boundary quality: HD95 is dominated by a few outlier slices; median surface error tells a different story
hyp: Method ranking by HD95 vs median surface distance disagrees on ≥25% of pairs on AMOS.
min_exp: Recompute public preds if available, else two models.

idea: Long-tail detection: copy-paste of tail classes onto head scenes creates context mismatch that models use inversely at test
hyp: A tail object in a canonical context is under-detected by copy-paste-trained models relative to a real-only model.
min_exp: Evaluate canonical vs pasted contexts.

idea: Annotation efficiency: one expert hour of quality control beats ten hours of extra naive labels for medical Dice
hyp: Relabeling the 10% worst training cases (by model-disagreement) matches the Dice of +100% extra raw labels.
min_exp: Simulate QC vs more data on a dataset with extra unused labels.

idea: Generalization: models that win in-domain medical challenges lose more under vendor shift
hyp: Negative correlation between challenge rank and vendor-shift Dice among top-10.
min_exp: Need multi-vendor test; use MSD + another vendor.

idea: Calibration: temperature scaling on logits fails for segmentation because different classes need different T
hyp: Per-class T reduces ECE more than global T without hurting Dice.
min_exp: Cityscapes/medical.

idea: Robustness to adversarial patches on SAM is worse for box prompts than point prompts
hyp: A patch that hijacks box-prompted masks fails to hijack a 1-click prompt on the same image more often than the reverse.
why: Which prompt to use under attack.
min_exp: Simple patch attack on SAM.
risk: Adversarial papers exist; keep as robustness eval not a new attack recipe.

idea: Synthetic data for SAM FT should match mask granularity (part vs object), not image style
hyp: Training on synthetic object-level masks and testing on part-level (or reverse) hurts more than a large style gap with matched granularity.
min_exp: Hypersim/SA-1B subsets by granularity.

idea: Cross-domain transfer of detectors fails more on aspect-ratio shift than on texture shift
hyp: Resizing objects to source aspect-ratio distribution recovers more AP than histogram matching in a target domain with different typical aspect ratios (e.g. aerial vs ground).
min_exp: DOTA vs COCO-style.

idea: Multimodal dense: audio of fire/smoke (crackle) as a cheap extra channel in surveillance, not extra RGB models
hyp: A tiny audio detector plus weak RGB reduces FAR at fixed recall vs RGB-only of much larger size.
why: Systems-level, not a bigger vis model.
min_exp: Public AV fire clips if available; else lab capture plan.
